facts.text: The town of Malta was originally called Dunning Street when it was formed in 1802 from part of Stillwater.
Malta's name is said to come from a local malt brewery in an area formerly called Malt-ville.
The village of Round Lake began in 1868 as a Methodist Episcopical Church camp meeting with 8,000 attendees the first year.
Malta is home to the Luther Forest Technology Campus, a massive site designed for semiconductor and nanotechnology manufacturing.
GlobalFoundries moved its corporate headquarters from Silicon Valley to a semiconductor manufacturing facility in Malta in April 2021.
Luther Forest was once a pioneering reforestation project and later served as a rocket fuel and ordnance test site.
